title: Family Gathering at Home
description: A warm domestic scene shows a woman in a purple velvet dress with white lace sitting on a floral couch, bottle-feeding one baby while another rests beside her. In the background, a bearded man sits on the floor playing with a red ball alongside several young children of diverse ethnicities, while other adults eat at a dining table behind them in a cozy, cluttered living room decorated with bunting and framed pictures.
prompt: A detailed realistic painting of a large multi-ethnic family gathered in a cozy vintage living room. A woman in an elegant purple velvet dress with white lace collar sits on a floral couch bottle-feeding a baby, while another infant lies beside her. A bearded man in a green shirt sits on the floor playing ball with several excited young children of different races. Other adults are visible eating at a dining table in the background. The room is filled with warm lamplight, patterned wallpaper, bunting flags, framed pictures, and toys scattered around, evoking a joyful and nostalgic family gathering.
